fragments.text: Greetings. I'm Sasha Renee Todd, and I've dedicated a large part of my professional journey to understanding the ecological services of freshwater habitats and the complexities of water challenges in our modern world. For the next few minutes, we will review the historical symbiosis between water and civilization, and explore a blueprint where AI becomes our AI, reviewing innovative strategies to address water stress. Essential for all biological processes, water is the building block of life on Earth. Every cell in our bodies require water to function. For this reason, the first human settlement sprang up around rivers and lakes. The availability of freshwater has always played a pivotal role in the settlement and growth of human populations throughout history, for drinking, agriculture, and transportation.

The increased demand for freshwater led to the construction of water infrastructure, such as dams and reservoirs.
